caseName: Cervieri v. Port of New York Authority
caseNameFull: CERVIERI et ux. v. PORT OF NEW YORK AUTHORITY
attorneys: Appellants pro se., Sidney Goldstein and Russell E. Watson for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari is denied.
